title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-agent-analytics-1-site: carry parked/agent/analytics-1-site onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/agent/analytics-1-site` at 3ccf39ecd5 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: .github/workflows/checks.yml, site/worker.js)
**Done check:** probe:git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/parked/agent/analytics-1-site is 0, or the branch's content is carried by a merged change
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M
